sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games and on an impressive run of form (W-D-W-W-W), host Alsager Town at home on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. Alsager are bottom of the league with just 4 points from 10 matches and have lost their last four games, making this a strong opportunity for Sandbach to extend their lead at the summit.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town face a stern test away at Dawley Town (who have mixed recent form with a win in their last outing), while third-ranked AFC Bridgnorth host Eccleshall in what could be a competitive mid-table encounter. Wolverhampton Casuals, fourth in the table, travel to Wednesfield Community. Bilston Town, sitting sixth, visit Foley Meir in a fixture between two relatively steady performers. In-form Barnton host Shawbury United, who are struggling badly with five losses in their last six. New Mills travel to Market Drayton Town in a bottom-half clash, while Allscott Heath visit Crewe—both teams with poor recent form. Cheadle Heath Nomads, with just 7 points, travel to face Telford Town (6 points), a bottom-of-the-table six-pointer. Finally, Brereton Social welcome winless Widnes Town, who remain adrift at the foot of the league with only 2 points from 7 games.
